# dionneanthon.com

> A resource site combining web hosting information and legal citation guidance, authored by Dionne E. Anthon.

This site provides practical information about web hosting services through Just Host and cPanel, alongside comprehensive legal citation resources centered on The Bluebook. It serves as a reference for both web administrators and legal professionals seeking citation standards.

## Key Topics

- The Bluebook
- Legal citation
- Web hosting
- cPanel
- Just Host
- 21st edition
- Citation rules
- Domain registration
- Law education
- PHP
- MySQL
- Linux
- Reference guide

## Legal Citation & Reference

- [The Bluebook Uncovered](https://dionneanthon.com/bbu/bbu21.html): Comprehensive 21st edition legal citation guide by Dionne E. Anthon covering Bluebook citation rules and standards for law education

## Web Hosting & Domain

- [dionneanthon.com](https://dionneanthon.com): Homepage hosted by Just Host with cPanel access and web hosting services for domain management
